verses.gurmukhi: ਢੇਸੀ ਜੋਧੁ ਹੁਸੰਗੁ ਹੈ ਗੋਇੰਦੁ ਗੋਲਾ ਹਸਿ ਮਿਲੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: ddesee jodh husa(n)g hai goi(n)dh golaa has mila(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Bhai Dhesi amd Bhai Jodha and Husang brahmins and Bhai Gobind and Gola meet with smiling faces.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਣੁ ਕੁਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਧੁਟੇ ਜੋਧੇ ਜਾਮੁ ਸੁਹੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: mohan kuk vakhaaneeaai dhuTe jodhe jaam suha(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Mohan is said to be of Kuk caste and Jodha and Jama adorn Dhutta village.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੰਞੁ ਪੰਨੂ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਪੀਰਾਣਾ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ਚਲੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: ma(n)n(j) pa(n)noo paravaan hai peeraanaa gur bhai chala(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Manjh, the blest one and pirana et al. conduct in the will of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਮਜਾ ਜਜਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਬਾਲਾ ਮਰਵਾਹਾ ਵਿਗਸੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: hamajaa jajaa jaaneeaai baalaa maravaahaa vigasa(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Bhai Hamaja, said to be Jaja, and Bala, the Marvaha behave delightfully.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਨੋ ਓਹਰੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਸੂਰੀ ਚਉਧਰੀ ਰਹੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: niramal naano oharee naal sooree chaudharee raha(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Nano Ohari is of pure mind and along with him remains Suri, the Chaudhary.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰਬਤਿ ਕਾਲਾ ਮੇਹਰਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੂ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: parabat kaalaa meharaa naal nihaaloo sev kara(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Inhabitants of mountains are Bhai kala and Mehara and with them Bhai Nihalu also serves.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਕਾ ਕਾਲਉ ਸੂਰਮਾ ਕਦੁ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ਬਚਨ ਮਨੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: kakaa kaalau sooramaa kadh raamadhaas bachan mana(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Brown coloured Kalu is brave and Ram Das belonging to kad caste is obeyer of the words of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੇਠ ਸਭਾਗਾ ਚੂਹਣੀਅਹੁ ਆਰੋੜੇ ਭਾਗ ਉਗਵੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: seTh sabhaagaa choohaneeahu aaroRe bhaag ugava(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Rich person Subhaga resides in Chuhania town and with him are Bhag Mal and Ugvanda, the Arora Sikhs.
All these are devotees surpassing one another.
